_comment: Outline-kernel M1 verb fixtures (DESIGN §9). `expect` is recorded from the window's TS functions by src/document/edits/kernelFixtures.test.ts (TINE_RECORD_KERNEL_FIXTURES=1) and checked against the Rust kernel by crates/tine-outline/tests/ops_fixtures.rs. A difference is investigated, never resolved by editing `expect` alone. Keys created by a verb are n0, n1, ...; focus is the editor offset (UTF-16, hidden properties removed), null keeps the caret. A case's `note` records an investigated difference from the pre-kernel TS that `expect` now takes.
